title: Listener stall watchdog is never armed, so a silent listener is not restarted when the session's own saves are not echoed
failureClass: silent listener never recovered (pair stops receiving listener events)
source: Multiplayer incident where a session's listener went silent and kept showing a paragraph another editor deleted; listener stall watchdog (watchForListenerStall) in getPairListener
userVisibleEffect: A session whose listener goes silent, or holds events forever in the multi-document transaction buffer, keeps showing a paragraph another editor deleted; edits to it save as no-ops with no warning, and nothing restarts the listener or reloads the document
